speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to my office. I see you are experiencing persistent vomiting and chest pain; tell me, when did these symptoms first start and how severe would you rate the pain on a scale of one to ten?

REQUEST TEST: Basic_Metabolic_Panel, Troponin, ECG
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_XRay

speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with persistent, forceful vomiting after consuming a significant amount of alcohol. His medical history includes recent treatment for Lyme disease with doxycycline. Recently, after a prolonged episode of retching, the patient starts to choke and cough forcefully, experiencing chest pain. The patient appears unable to communicate effectively at this point.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Significant for Lyme disease, currently being treated with doxycycline. Social history: Reported alcohol use; found next to an empty bottle of vodka.

speaker: Patient
text: Patient appears toxic and in acute distress, unable to provide a comprehensive review of systems. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Migraine and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: I cannot accept the suggestion that this is a migraine given your toxic appearance and acute distress; I need to verify if you have any fever, chills, or recent head trauma to rule out serious infections or intracranial issues while we await your blood work and X-ray. REQUEST TEST: CBC, CT_Head, LFTs, Amylase.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal readings on your tests are reassuring, but your toxic appearance and persistent vomiting require further clarification; have you noticed any blood in your vomit or passed black, tarry stools recently? Additionally, do you have a history of gallbladder disease or pancreatitis?

REQUEST TEST: Lipase, Amylase
REQUEST TEST: Upper_GI_Series

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal readings on your blood work and imaging so far are encouraging, but since I still see a toxic appearance with persistent vomiting, do you have any specific food allergies, recent travel history, or take any new medications that could be causing this? REQUEST TEST: Drug_Screen, Toxicology_Panel.

speaker: Doctor
text:
With the toxicology panel also showing normal readings, I need to narrow down the cause of your persistent vomiting and chest pain; did you consume any wild mushrooms, shellfish, or unpasteurized dairy in the last 24 hours, and do you have a history of alcohol use disorder?

REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Panel, Arterial_Blood_Gas

speaker: Doctor
text:
I have reviewed your normal labs and imaging so far; before we conclude, I need to clarify if your chest pain is specifically associated with deep breaths or movement, and have you had any recent abdominal surgery?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Gastritis with secondary dehydration
